from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,concurrent.futures,hashlib
out=Path.cwd()/'.work/vm-align64-20261116'
def run(item):
 name,target=item;cmd=['zig','build','-Dtarget='+target,'-Doptimize=fast','-Dcpu=baseline','-Dstrip=false','--prefix',str(out/name),'--summary','all']
 with (out/(name+'-build.log')).open('wb') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=out/'candidate',stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 assert r.returncode==0,(name,r.returncode)
 binary=out/name/'bin'/('sigma.exe' if name=='windows' else 'sigma');return {'platform':name,'command':cmd,'exit':r.returncode,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':binary.stat().st_size}
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as p:rows=list(p.map(run,[('windows','x86_64-windows-gnu'),('linux','x86_64-linux-musl')]))
(out/'builds.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');print('both alignment-control builds completed')
